title.en: Stabilize classroom share timestamps and enforce clean authored source
title.zh: 稳定课堂共享时间并强制业务源码零告警

purpose.en: Prevent classroom share-card timestamps from changing between Cloudflare server rendering and the visitor browser, while removing dead classroom code and making zero-error, zero-warning ESLint a permanent production gate.
purpose.zh: 防止课堂共享卡片时间在 Cloudflare 服务端渲染与访客浏览器之间发生变化，同时删除课堂死代码，并将 ESLint 零错误、零警告设为永久生产门禁。

en: Render classroom share-card dates in the same explicit America/Los_Angeles timezone already used by classroom directory and detail views.
Remove the unused legacy PlaylistViewer and clean stale imports, hook effects, dynamic-media lint contracts, and cleanup refs.
Run authored-source ESLint with max warnings set to zero on every production deployment.
zh: 课堂共享卡片使用与课堂目录和详情页相同的明确 America/Los_Angeles 时区渲染日期。
删除未使用的旧 PlaylistViewer，并清理失效导入、Hook effect、动态媒体 lint 契约及清理引用。
每次生产发布均以最大警告数为零执行业务源码 ESLint。

en: Classroom share images, classroom playback and screen-share components, authored-source lint policy, deployment workflow, and Project release history
zh: 课堂分享图片、课堂播放与屏幕共享组件、业务源码 lint 策略、发布工作流及 Project 发布历史

en: Pin localized share-image time formatting to America/Los_Angeles to eliminate server/browser hydration drift.
Replace synchronous effect state changes with deferred callbacks or derived state, and stabilize media element cleanup references.
Exclude only documented generated build output and pinned third-party browser bundles while continuing to lint app, components, and library source.
zh: 将本地化分享图片时间格式固定到 America/Los_Angeles，消除服务端与浏览器水合偏差。
用延迟回调或派生状态替代 effect 中的同步状态修改，并稳定媒体元素清理引用。
仅排除已记录的生成构建输出和固定版本第三方浏览器包，继续检查 app、components 与 lib 业务源码。

en: Require ESLint to complete with exactly zero errors and zero warnings, then run the full site tests, shared classroom contracts, protected-navigation check, production build, and artifact validation.
Deploy the exact validated Git commit through GitHub Actions and Cloudflare and verify its detailed Project release record.
zh: 要求 ESLint 精确达到零错误、零警告，再执行整站测试、共享课堂契约、受保护导航检查、生产构建及产物验证。
通过 GitHub Actions 与 Cloudflare 发布完全相同且已验证的 Git 提交，并核对其详细 Project 发布记录。

en: This portfolio migration does not change classroom pricing, permissions, realtime participant limits, wallet contracts, game rewards, or payment behavior.
zh: 本轮组合迁移不改变课堂定价、权限、实时参与人数限制、钱包合约、游戏奖励或付款行为。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, games, reward logs, swap bundles, wallet integration, independent data, and Cloudflare resources; retain its documented generated swap-assets exclusion.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、游戏、奖励日志、Swap 资源、钱包集成、独立数据与 Cloudflare 资源，并保留其已记录的生成 swap-assets 排除规则。
